set.body:
Outcome: unify source/model/consumer requirements under an inspectable execution plan and qualify masked multi-run estimated-AR analysis through an actual browser render.
Scope: fmrimod planning/orchestration and shared ingress preflight; reuse regression/group providers. No detached-fit execution extension, durable cache, new solver, real/restricted data without explicit approval, or publication.
Invariants: no voxel reads at plan construction/inspection; output uncertainty is compiled from named consumers; storage/workers/retention and known numeric reservations visible before run; never change noise/rank/estimands to fit a budget; exact model/source reuse; failed updates preserve prior requests/state.
Design: CohortAnalysis with fixed immutable NIfTI sources, replaceable SubjectRequests, ExecutionPolicy, inspect() and run(). Expected use steers Auto storage; retention remains explicit. Share file executor reservation logic rather than duplicate it. Inspect per-subject data/model/fit actions and consumer output maps. Reserve external collector memory explicitly.
Acceptance: parity with low-level paths; no-read planning, output union/name/model binding, budget/worker choices, transactional update, actual reuse and estimated-AR design invalidation tests; default-feature build and scoped test/clippy/fmt. Synthetic masked two-run fixture unless user supplies approved path. Browser harness submits design to a localhost server, exercises slice changes, records request-to-render-opportunity time and screenshots; scientific values checked separately.
Risks: shared active group development; reserve only named first-level paths, bind exact live source hashes. Disk under 20GB: reuse existing workspace target for incremental checks; no new full build cache. Browser profile lean-browser-playwright, installed Playwright Chromium, pre/post ownership audit and finally cleanup.
Next action: reserve paths, implement shared preflight and planner; ask dataset preference while continuing independent work.
set.title: Inspectable cohort analysis planning and browser qualification
